entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf improvement: antiforgery-generation #64197
  • How to handle SignalR reconnection logic in React without triggering useEffect on every state change? #64196
  • can't bind to `open` attribute on `<details>` or `<dialog>` elements #64194
  • Microsoft.OpenAPI bad schema refs when involving collections #64193
  • Perf improvement: multiple_queries #64191
  • RootComponentTypeCache Prevents Dynamic Component Regeneration in Interactive Server Mode (Still) #64189

Closed

  • Allow Environment specific Secrets.json #64187
  • System.Text.Json fails to serialize JwtBearerOptions in .NET 10 with Events delegates present #64168
  • OpenIdConnect: Skip idp redirect if EndSessionEndpoint is not set #64154

PullRequests

Merged

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #64176
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops, 11.0-preview1

    area-blazor, community-contribution, 11.0-preview1

Updated

  • Stop using 2.x packages in InProcessNewShimWebsite testasset #64120
    area-infrastructure
  • Fix ResponseCompression tests to work with different zlib implementations #63988
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-middleware

    area-mvc, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
